item.title: Boron Ester Mediating Interface to Accelerate Ion Transport for Long-Cycling Solid-State Sodium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Boron ester interface engineering is novel: it forms a stable, ion-conductive interphase between solid electrolytes and sodium electrodes, lowering interfacial resistance and accelerating Na⁺ transport. This enables dendrite suppression and long-cycling solid-state sodium metal batteries, offering a practical route to safer, high-energy storage.
🏷 solid-state sodium battery · boron ester · interface · ion transport · long cycling

item.title: Bio-inspired self-assembly of ordered interface topology for robust composite solid electrolytes
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a bio-inspired self-assembly strategy to engineer ordered interface topology in composite solid electrolytes. Its novelty lies in mimicking biological assembly to simultaneously achieve fast ion transport, stable interfaces, and strong dendrite suppression. The significance is a robust electrolyte combining high conductivity, mechanical strength, and excellent cycling stability, advancing safe, high-performance solid-state batteries.
🏷 composite solid electrolyte · bio-inspired self-assembly · interface topology · ion transport · dendrite suppression

item.title: Crystal-Water Regulation Governs Prussian Blue Cathodes in Liquid-Batteries and Halide Solid-State Batteries
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work reveals that residual crystal water in Prussian blue cathodes acts as a tunable regulator, not merely an impurity, governing electrochemical performance across liquid and halide solid-state sodium batteries. By clarifying this crystal-water regulation mechanism, it offers a unified design principle for stabilizing PB cathodes, advancing high-performance SIBs in both electrolyte systems.
🏷 Prussian blue · crystal water · sodium-ion battery · solid-state battery · cathode

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a multi-site high-entropy NiCoFeCrAlY alloy enabling concurrent biomass aldehyde electrooxidation and self-discharging battery operation. Its significance is combining multi-functional catalysis with energy recovery, offering a versatile, efficient route for biomass upgrading while generating power, advancing sustainable biorefining and multifunctional electrode design.
